name: Third Position
summary: Third Position is a post-war neo-fascist current that presents itself as a revolutionary-nationalist third force against both Western capitalism and Eastern-bloc communism. It combines corporatist, distributist or solidarist economics and anti-usury politics with racial or ethnic nationalism, rejection of liberal democracy, and a militant, spiritual cadre ethos. It opposes both superpowers and sympathises with national liberation movements and anti-Zionist causes.
scope: The mainstream European strand of the 1970s to the present: Terza Posizione (Fiore, Adinolfi, Dimitri), the British National Front's Political Soldier wing (Holland, Griffin), the International Third Position and Forza Nuova's programme. It draws on Evola, Strasserism and Mosley. It excludes the Argentine Peronist usage, National Bolshevism as a separate ideology, and Dugin's Fourth Political Theory.

sources.author: Connexipedia (adapted from Wikipedia)
sources.usedFor: Neither left nor right self-description; corporatist, distributist or solidarist economics; separate-but-equal ethnic separatism.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Third Position rejects Western capitalism and favours corporatist or distributist economics, so unregulated markets are not seen as the best allocator.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Wealth redistribution is a listed Third Position economic aim, so heavier taxes on the rich fit.

unions-good.rationale: Adherents champion workers but want existing unions replaced by corporative bodies, so they are split on unions as they stand.

cut-welfare.rationale: The programme pledges minimum living thresholds, healthcare and schooling for all, against a general welfare cut.

worker-ownership.rationale: Workers' cooperatives and family-owned firms are listed among Third Position economic proposals.

state-harmful.rationale: Third Position wants a corporatist state and a revolutionary nation-state, not statelessness.

empower-police-military.rationale: Italian Third Position is described as militarist with a soldier lifestyle, favouring strong security forces.

decide-locally.rationale: The SPLC reports a Third Position preference for power devolved to the lowest level possible.

traditional-family.rationale: The programme centres family support and Forza Nuova's Catholic-traditionalist lineage, while Evolian tradition values the family.

more-religion-public.rationale: The programme seeks a restored Christian Europe and rejects secularist views, though some strands are neopagan.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Racial nationalism and separatism leave no place for programmes to repair historical racial injustices.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Holland's Political Soldier opposes cultural mixing and defends national identity as central.

gradual-change.rationale: The Political Soldier is a revolutionary figure aiming at radical change, not gradualism.

reduce-immigration.rationale: The SPLC notes many Third Positionists oppose immigrants, and the aim is homogeneous nations.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Holland's slogan rejected both superpowers, and the movement stresses national sovereignty.

free-trade.rationale: The programme proposes higher customs duties on goods Europe already produces and near food self-sufficiency.

nation-first.rationale: National freedom and sovereignty are central; pan-European strands still put the nation-bloc above global bodies.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: The movement is anti-imperialist and opposed to Western military power, so humanitarian pretexts are distrusted.

open-borders.rationale: The goal of ethnically homogeneous states is incompatible with open borders.

limit-growth.rationale: Environmentalist and ruralist strands favour limits, while nationalist-economic strands want strong production.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Evola-influenced anti-materialism distrusts the idea that technology will solve humanity's problems.

revolution-justified.rationale: Third Position calls itself revolutionary nationalism and seeks to replace existing governments.

experts-over-public.rationale: The favoured elite is a spiritual cadre of political soldiers, not technocratic experts.

central-planning.rationale: Corporatism accepts state guidance of markets but not a fully planned economy; family property and small firms are protected.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: The programme explicitly proposes higher customs duties and protection for agriculture and small firms.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Holland made distributism the foundation of the NF programme, favouring small businesses and family or community land ownership.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Corporatist and distributist schemes keep wages and property, unlike communism which Third Position rejects.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: The programme wants states, not private banks or markets, to issue money, so it rejects a market-money system.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Scholars describe the usual Third Position economy as corporatist, with employers and workers in organised bodies.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Evolian traditionalism would admit sacral kingship but the movements are republican revolutionaries.

democracy-best.rationale: The article says these movements rejected liberal democracy outright.

workers-councils.rationale: Corporatist organic bodies are preferred to councils replacing the state, which is a Marxist-left idea.

right-to-secede.rationale: Some movements wanted existing states broken into homogeneous ethnic units, though pan-European strands differ.

natural-rulers.rationale: The Political Soldier concept draws on Evola to call for a new elite against bourgeois decadence.

political-violence-never.rationale: Holland praised readiness to die for a cause, and the Italian wing is linked to armed groups, so violence is not ruled out.

war-builds-character.rationale: Italian Third Position cultivated a soldier lifestyle and militarism.

separate-church-state.rationale: The programme rejects secularist outlooks and wants a Christian Europe, though pagan strands exist.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Catholic integralists lean yes, Evolian and neopagan strands do not.

private-courts-defense.rationale: A militarist state-centred movement would not privatise defence or courts.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The article says the aim was homogeneous states built on ethnic nations or a pan-European nation.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Third Position rejects Marxism and class struggle in favour of national solidarity.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Hierarchy and elite are valued; some redistribution is wanted but not equal outcomes.

civilizational-union.rationale: Pan-European cooperation and a Christian Europe in the programme favour union of kindred civilization.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Holland defines the political soldier by a spiritual ideal of sacrifice, against materialist self-interest.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The Political Soldier subordinates the person to the cause with almost fanatical devotion.

limit-population.rationale: The programme's family and natality emphasis points against limiting population.

accelerate-technology.rationale: The anti-materialist, traditionalist outlook is wary of disruptive technological change.

algorithmic-government.rationale: A political-soldier ethos of personal virtue and loyalty contradicts rule by algorithms.

restore-past-order.rationale: Evola-style traditionalism looks to a lost order, though adherents frame it as a new revolutionary man.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Adherents are ideological and spiritual, defining themselves against both capitalism and communism.

direct-action.rationale: Political soldiers favour militant activism over parliamentary routes, though Forza Nuova contests elections.

means-match-ends.rationale: Holland praised hard disciplined struggle regardless of its fit to the future society.

return-to-foraging.rationale: The movements want organised nation-states, not hunter-gatherer life.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: A corporatist order with organised trades assumes the division of labour.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Corporatism ties reward to productive function and rank, not need alone.

production-for-use.rationale: The programme condemns abstract usurious finance and favours real production.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Class collaboration replaces the Marxist exploitation thesis; blame falls on finance and usury instead.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Third Position opposes Marxist communism of the Eastern bloc.

collective-farming.rationale: Distributism favours family land ownership, the opposite of collectivised farms.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Holland's slogans target Washington and Moscow as warmongers, and capitalism is condemned, but the inevitability thesis is Marxist.

taxation-theft.rationale: A state-centred redistributive movement does not regard taxes as theft.

harm-principle.rationale: The soldier ethos of duty and moral discipline rejects a purely harm-based limit on state power.

individual-rights-only.rationale: The movement is collectivist and nation-centred, with duties before rights.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Loyalty to the nation as a community is central, against a leave-if-you-dislike-it view.

state-as-business.rationale: Spiritual, duty-based statecraft rejects treating citizens as customers.

media-academia-power.rationale: Holland wrote of Zionist-controlled media, reflecting belief that media hold hidden power.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Racial nationalists treat race as real, though Yockey and Evola-influenced strands prefer spiritual racism.

organic-representation.rationale: The corporatist and solidarist model has people represented through organic bodies, not parties.

total-state.rationale: Third Position favours devolving power to the lowest level, though corporatism gives the state a large role.

national-rebirth.rationale: The Political Soldier concept is a call for a new elite and radical regeneration against the decadence of modern bourgeois society.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Holland demanded national freedom for enslaved nations and opposed imperialism rather than expansion.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Holland cited the Romanian Iron Guard as a model of oath-bound devotion.

bound-labor.rationale: Distributist small ownership of land by farmers is the opposite of bound labour.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: No documented position; Evolian traditionalists distrust modern science while others do not.

universal-morality.rationale: Catholic strands affirm universal truths, ethnopluralists stress culturally distinct values.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Holland's NF campaigned under the slogan Smash Zionism and opposed organised Jewish power, so a Jewish state is rejected.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Ethnonational thinking supports return of kin to a homeland, though not directly documented.

school-vouchers.rationale: The programme promises good schooling for all through the state, while vouchers are a liberal market tool.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: The programme blames Maastricht austerity for precarious work, so deficit restraint is not prized.

economic-freedom.rationale: Third Position denies that liberal economic freedom underpins freedom.

rule-by-example.rationale: The political soldier is meant to lead by spiritual example.

national-self-determination.rationale: Holland's Nationalism Today called for National Freedom for the enslaved nations of the world.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Holland defined the political soldier by a spiritual and religious ideal.

class-collaboration.rationale: Corporatist and solidarist economics put workers and bosses in cooperation to prevent class conflict.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Defending tradition and national cultural continuity is central.

dominated-front.rationale: The movement sympathised with Third World national liberation and cooperated with Gaddafi's Libya.

workers-nation.rationale: Third Position defends productive workers within the nation, against international class solidarity.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Racial separatism is stated, but the emphasis is separate homelands, not legal segregation within one state.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Marxist class analysis of the state is rejected.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Racial separatists want fewer immigrants and doubt assimilation, yet cultural nationalists demand conformity.

proportional-representation.rationale: Parliamentary parties are rejected in favour of corporative representation.

national-mission.rationale: Holland defended each nation's own freedom, not spreading one government type.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The programme calls EU leaders an oligarchic lobby and the movement attacks parliamentary politicians.

night-watchman-state.rationale: A corporatist, interventionist economy and strong state are the opposite.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Holland opposed racial and cultural mixing and the movement backs racial separatism.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Many adherents hold whites superior, though others say separate but equal.

socialism-one-country.rationale: The movement is nationalist and rejects international revolution.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: A strong state among hostile blocs is natural for a militarist movement, but socialism is not its aim.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Authority rests on nation and elite, not on liberal consent.

trade-surplus.rationale: Protectionist, self-sufficient economics fit a surplus-seeking stance.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Holland praised militant struggle, and the movement is linked to political violence.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Struggle and martial virtue are valued, though economic competition is not.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: The movement itself would be targeted and rejects liberal constitutional order.

separated-powers.rationale: Liberal checks and balances are rejected with liberal democracy.

vanguard-party.rationale: Political soldiers form an elite cadre intended to lead the nation.

priority-to-poor.rationale: The programme's social thresholds and class-solidarity make the poor a priority within the nation.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Distributism favours widespread home and property ownership.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Corporatism restricts strikes, but the movement appeals to workers.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: The programme blames usurious finance and Maastricht, not population, for hardship.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Homogeneous ethnic states and rejection of multiculturalism are core aims.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Rule by an elite of political soldiers contradicts random selection.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Political soldiers are bound by strict discipline.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The programme condemns EU leadership as oligarchic, though a pan-European confederation is also admired.

head-commands-forces.rationale: A leader-centred militarist outlook favours executive command.

clerical-rule.rationale: Catholic integralists admire religious authority, but the movement is led by political soldiers, not clergy.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Holland's patriotism and nationalism oppose defeatism, despite anti-superpower rhetoric.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Leader-centred anti-liberal politics does not support term limits.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Holland's slogan was No to Washington, No to Moscow, rejecting both military blocs.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Terza Posizione drew on Evola's ruralism and the ITP promoted a back-to-the-land ideal, valuing rural over urban life.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Ethnopluralism claims cultures are different and should stay separate, though some adherents hold supremacist views.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: The political soldier ideal is conformity to a disciplined order.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: An authoritarian outlook accepts temporary restrictions for national ends.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: A leader-centred outlook suits plebiscitary election of a head of state.

central-bank-independence.rationale: The programme wants money issued by states, not independent banks.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Distributism and Catholic social teaching place property within community obligations.

collective-defense.rationale: Holland's slogan No to Washington, No to Moscow rejected both superpower blocs, and Terza Posizione sought to sabotage the two blocs.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: The programme values a Christian Europe, and traditionalist Catholics resist state control of church.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Homogeneous states and ethnic homelands are favoured, so forcibly keeping regions is not.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Wealth redistribution is favoured, so progressive taxation is preferred to flat.

character-from-environment.rationale: Racial nationalism and Evolian ideas stress innate nature and blood.

space-expansion.rationale: Anti-materialist traditionalism sees this as a distraction from spiritual renewal.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Rejects Marxist theory; so the premise is not accepted.

land-redistribution.rationale: Distributism wants land spread among those who farm it.

refugee-return.rationale: Holland's Victory to Palestine campaign backed Palestinian causes, implying return.

common-currency.rationale: The programme blames the Maastricht Treaty and wants states to issue money.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Pan-European nationalism, such as Mosley's Europe a Nation, is documented as core.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Racial separatism favours separate homelands rather than integration.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Evola-influenced spiritualism rejects materialism as the driver of history.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Rejects liberal constitutional constraints on national will.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Traditionalist outlook opposes quotas for women and men.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: The programme proposes near food self-sufficiency and a European protected bloc.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Protectionism is preferred to trade agreements of any kind.

moral-incentives.rationale: Political soldier ethos relies on devotion and sacrifice more than reward.

history-own-civilization.rationale: National cultural and Christian-European identity emphasised.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Holland's call for national freedom for enslaved nations rejects tutelage.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Racial separatists reject programmes favouring other races.

public-money-creation.rationale: The 2009 programme states money should be issued by states rather than by banks lending at debit.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Third Position claims capitalism is a flawed system to be replaced.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: The movement presents workers as productive members of the nation, not beneficiaries of exploitation.

minority-veto.rationale: A leadership-centred organic order rejects veto rights.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Rural traditional life accepts farming with humane limits.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Solidarist and distributist ethos stresses the duties of the privileged to the community.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Political soldiers are defined by total commitment to political struggle.

party-own-road.rationale: National paths are central to nationalist doctrine.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Self-sufficiency is a stated aim of the programme.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Third Position is neo-fascist and denies this.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Catholic traditionalist family doctrine opposes easy divorce.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Distributism wants families to own land, not hold it only while using it.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Racial nationalism rejects anti-discrimination frameworks of this type.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Holland rejected materialism as a decadent bourgeois ethos.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Rejects both superpower blocs and their interventions.

corporate-influence.rationale: The programme calls the EU leadership an oligarchic lobby and condemns neoliberal globalisation.

democratic-peace.rationale: Rejects liberal democracy and its promotion.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Political soldier ethos stresses discipline and duty.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: The SPLC says virtually all Third Positionists identify the multiculturalist Jew as their prime enemy.

local-production.rationale: The programme favours food self-sufficiency and protecting agriculture.

informal-organisation.rationale: Political soldier cadres are disciplined organisations, not informal affinity groups.

religious-nation.rationale: The programme seeks a Christian Europe, but most strands define nations by ethnicity.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Holland's slogan rejected submission to Washington or Moscow.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Distributism protects private property of families.

defeat-communism.rationale: Anti-communism is central, though the movement equally opposes capitalism and some favour red-brown alliance.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: The programme promises healthcare and schooling for all but never says who should deliver them.

religion-illusion.rationale: Holland's spiritual and religious ideal rejects this view.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Third Position rejects capitalism as a Western system to be replaced.

socialized-care.rationale: Traditional family emphasis opposes socialising childcare.

cooperative-communities.rationale: The ITP bought a remote Spanish village in 1997 for a back-to-the-land community, showing sympathy for small communal settlements.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: The article defines Third Position as a third force between Western capitalism and Eastern Bloc communism.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Third Position advocates describe it as neither left nor right, drawing on ideas from both, and some figures favoured red-brown alliances.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Third Position writing is strongly hostile to Jews and some strands deny or minimise the Holocaust, but adherents differ; low confidence because the sources open do not state it.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Third Position opposes Western capitalism and sympathises with national liberation movements, so it rejects running colonies for the ruling country's benefit.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Third Position sympathises with anti-Western resistance but has no doctrine of a religious duty on all Muslims; adherents are split or indifferent.

islam-incompatible.rationale: European Third Position groups stress ethnic and cultural identity and oppose mass immigration, but also sympathise with anti-Zionist Muslim causes, so adherents are divided.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Forza Nuova's Catholic traditionalism opposes secularist restrictions, though the sources state no position on dress.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: The political-soldier ethos is militant and nationalist, so abolishing armed forces is rejected.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Third Position defines itself as a third force against both the Western and Eastern blocs.

reification.rationale: Third Position attacks capitalism but rarely uses this concept, which comes from Marxist theory; adherents are indifferent, so a neutral inference.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Third Position strands are mostly ethnic and racial and some Catholic, with no stated marriage law on religion; adherents differ.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Some strands, sharing anti-Zionist and antisemitic politics, favour shunning minority businesses; the plank is not general to the current, so low confidence.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Its anti-usury politics and distributist economics treat concentrated finance and capital as a threat to the nation.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Third Position favours homogeneous states and is hostile to immigrants, so non-citizens voting is rejected.

uniformed-youth.rationale: The political soldier ideal is a disciplined cadre devoted to the cause, and the movement builds drilled youth organisations.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: It opposes both Western and Eastern blocs and the European Union leadership, and demands national sovereignty.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Not covered in the sources; adherents are divided and often hostile to some recognitions, so this is a split.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Anti-usury politics, abolishing interest and state-issued money are core, favouring work over returns from capital.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: The political soldier's fanatical devotion and readiness to fight make killing for the cause justified.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: The political soldier ideal is sacrifice and religious zeal, and martyrs of the cause are venerated.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Derek Holland's writings and Evola frame politics as a religious and spiritual fight against materialism.

culture-before-state.rationale: Political soldiers stress a spiritual and cultural renewal, but also seek state power; the sources do not settle which comes first.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Homogeneous states, hostility to minorities and self-sufficiency in its programme tie economic life to the national majority.

independent-unions.rationale: Corporatist and solidarist economics integrate unions into the national order rather than leaving them separate from the state.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Third Position rejects class struggle in favour of class collaboration within the nation, so working-class power is not its test.

municipal-property.rationale: Distributism favours wide private property and solidarism favours national organisation, not municipal ownership.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Its revolutionary-nationalist politics favour a strong centralised state over federal bodies of local assemblies.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Its anti-usury politics oppose finance, but it also favours a strong state, so it has no clear stance on untraceable payments.

person-over-state.rationale: Political Soldier ideology subordinates the individual to the organic nation and cadre discipline.

spiritual-nature.rationale: The political-soldier ethos is explicitly spiritual and draws on Evola's traditionalism, with politics serving spiritual renewal.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Third Position is built on racial or ethnic nationalism and holds that each people must organise to defend its own interests.

racial-pride.rationale: It treats racial or ethnic identity as a positive value to be defended and celebrated.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: It opposes both superpowers, but its militant political-soldier ethos is not tied to a defensive-only rule; adherents are split.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Third Position casts Western capitalism, Zionism and the superpowers as forces undermining national identity, a conspiratorial view of outside plots.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Third Position exalts virile, martial ideals and a heroic cadre ethos, and it holds sex roles to be natural; the claim that women bring distinct values is accepted but not prioritised, hence a mild disagreement with giving them more weight.

capital-controls.rationale: Third Position economics opposes global finance capital and usury and wants the nation to control its economy; capital controls follow from that.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Its militant, hierarchical soldier ethos and nationalism leave no room for refusing orders in inter-state war.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: It opposes both superpowers and sympathises with Third World and national liberation causes against Western capitalism.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Its corporatist and distributist programme is a definite economic blueprint for the nation.

sacred-nation.rationale: Its core is a spiritual, organic ethnic nationalism in which the nation outlasts and gives meaning to individuals.

student-debt-relief.rationale: The movement never addresses it; anti-usury sentiment points toward relief but its elitist cadre ethos and ethnic limits make it uncertain.

shared-human-nature.rationale: It rejects liberal universalism and human-rights doctrine, treating peoples as unequal and distinct; the 'new man' is a project of remaking.

farm-price-support.rationale: Its distributist, anti-usury economics aim to shield small producers such as farmers from finance, as the programme describes.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: It favours traditional gender roles but says little about property rights, so adherents are taken as split.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: The sources describe Third Position as rejecting liberal democracy and pursuing an organic, hierarchical state, not election-based legitimacy.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Holland's writings make a religious ideal central and reject materialism, so adherents deny that religion is a cause of women's oppression.

race-social-construct.rationale: The sources describe racial and ethnic separatism with homogeneous nations, which treats races as real natural groupings.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Nationalist sovereignty and hostility to supranational bodies mean leaders are judged only by their own nations.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Third Positionists embrace a religious ideal (Christian, Evolan or pagan traditionalism) but not uniformly literalist scripture; strands are split.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Ethnic separatism favours homogeneous homelands, but it opposes ethnic autonomy within a unitary nation-state; strands split.

simple-living.rationale: The back-to-the-land ideal and anti-materialism favour limited needs and self-sufficiency.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Its ethnic nationalism and Forza Nuova's programme stress defending national kin and identity beyond the borders.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Its anti-usury politics opposes finance capital and plutocratic privilege.

national-resource-control.rationale: Its anti-capitalist, anti-usury nationalism demands national sovereignty over resources against international finance.

multipolar-world.rationale: Third Position opposes both the US and the Soviet bloc and sympathises with national liberation movements, which favours several independent centres of power.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: It joins nationalism with solidarist, corporatist economics for workers and rejects both capitalism and communism, so patriotism and working people's interests belong together.

material-over-identity.rationale: The current's core is racial or ethnic nationalism, so it holds identity above a material-only left.

missingStatements.text: The division of politics into left and right is outdated, and the best ideas of each should be combined.
missingStatements.rationale: Third Position advocates describe it as neither left nor right, drawing on ideas from both, and some figures favoured red-brown alliances.

notes: Strands differ: Catholic traditionalists (Holland, Fiore, Forza Nuova) versus Evolian or neopagan and environmentalist currents; American and Argentine uses of the label differ again. Many statements are not addressed in the sources and are inferred (low confidence). The primary evidence is limited to a programme summary and quotations of Holland reported by a secondary source.
